calibration.method: Two full live vector-OFF runs (2026-10-24) with JUKE_EVALS_JUDGE_RUNS=2 per case; reported means are the average of those runs. Mean targets are set ~0.15 below the lower run (noise margin). Per-case floors are 2.0 on all judge dimensions. No-false-claims is enforced by per-case grounding + schema hard gates (vector cases when index is on).
